scope: External bounded process-tree RSS sampling and explicit post-warmup window summaries

root_acceptance.review: Root reviewed receipt bounds, PID/create-time identity, recursive RSS sum, error handling, raw-row window compatibility and missed-deadline scheduling. The final synthetic parent waits for its child to exit before writing its completion receipt.

runtime_contract.window_bounds: Caller must supply actual warmup-end and run-end UTC times; bar counts are not inferred from elapsed time.
runtime_contract.completion_receipt: An explicitly supplied public completion_receipt.json containing only status, closed or cleanup_complete, and receipt_id.
runtime_contract.observations: PID/create_time, UTC/monotonic time, per-process and total RSS, validity, missing samples and finite error categories only.

limitations: No live run was observed in this round and no account acceptance increased.
The sampler neither stops a process nor reads command lines, environments, trading configuration, tapes or journals.
A completion receipt is an external assertion, not independent proof of native cleanup or remote account state.
Actual memory acceptance still needs adequate first/last window coverage and separate line/cohort/cache capacity evidence.
The accepted package wheel and SDK were not rebuilt or modified.
